source_title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection day 7: Rajinikanth, Mohanlal and Nelson Dilipkumar film earns Rs 582.45 - The Times of India
source_excerpt: 'Jailer 2', starring Rajinikanth and Mohanlal, witnessed a decline in box office collections on its seventh day in theaters. The action drama earned Rs 28.15 cr in India net collections on Wednesday, October 21. This represented a 39.9% drop from the previous day's Rs 46.80 cr. According to Sacnilk, the film has crossed the Rs 300 cr milestone in domestic net earnings, while its worldwide gross collection has reached Rs 582.45 cr.Jailer 2 Movie ReviewThe film's India gross collection stands at Rs 371.45 cr, with domestic net earnings totaling Rs 317.20 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 7 cr on Wednesday, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 211 cr. The film's seventh-day performance came after several days of substantial theatrical earnings across multiple language versions.'Jailer 2' day 7 language-wise collectionThe Tamil version led the domestic box office on Wednesday, earning Rs 18.50 cr from 6,914 shows. The Telugu version collected Rs 6 cr across 2,187 screenings. Evening and night screenings recorded 53.31% and 53.08%, respectively.The Hindi version registered 24.77% overall occupancy. Its morning shows recorded 13.42%, followed by 25.08% in the afternoon, 29.75% in the evening and 30.83% at night.The Telugu version posted 43.48% overall occupancy. Morning screenings registered 24.92%, afternoon shows reached 49.42%, evening screenings recorded 53.08%, and night shows stood at 46.50%.The film recorded Rs 33 cr in state-wise gross collections on Wednesday. Tamil Nadu contributed Rs 10.75 cr, while Karnataka added Rs 7.25 cr. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together accounted for Rs 7 cr. Kerala contributed Rs 4.75 cr, and the remaining Indian markets added Rs 3.25 cr.The film recorded 1,853,141 footfalls on Wednesday, taking its cumulative theatrical footfalls to 20,863,114. With its worldwide gross at Rs 582.45 cr, 'Jailer 2' continues its theatrical run despite the latest midweek decline. Directed by Nelson, Rajinikanth plays the lead character in 'Jailer 2', which is getting terrific reviews from the audiences.
